```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# R tooles
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(cmapR)
library(readxl)
# library(plotly)
# library(DT) # for JS datatable features

# HTML / RMD tools
library(knitr)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)
library(kableExtra)

create_tmp_file=FALSE # set to TRUE to make JSON files, useful for testing in CodePen
send_df_to_js <- function(df, id="data", na_val="null"){ # send df to javascript variable in json format
  cat(
    paste(
    '<script>
      const ', id,' = ',toJSON(df, digits=22, na=na_val),';
    </script>'
    , sep="")
  )
}
send_param_to_js <- function(param_val, param_name) {
  cat(paste(
    '<script>
      const ',param_name,' = "',param_val,'";
    </script>', sep=""))
}

```

```{r import_data, include=FALSE}
#### import panoply_nmf tarfile ####
untar(params$metaboanalyst_results, exdir = getwd()) # untar results in PWD
# locate necessary inputs from tar, and error if ANY are missing
file_metaboanalyst_opt = list.files(pattern = 'metaboanalyst_opt.Rdata$') # locate Rdata object containing parameters
if (length(file_metaboanalyst_opt) != 1) stop(glue("Tarfile {params$metaboanalyst_results} is missing metaboanalyst_opt.Rdata object, containing parameters used in panoply_metaboanalyst."))
log_file = list.files(pattern="*log_file.csv$") # locate combined GCT file
if (length(log_file) != 1) stop(glue("Tarfile {params$metaboanalyst_results} is missing logfile of successfully analyzed annotations."))

#### Finish Setup / File Import ####
# load in panoply_metaboanalyst parameters
load(file_metaboanalyst_opt) # load opt list object (panoply_metaboanalyst. parameters)
# load in log file
log_file = read.csv(log_file)

# Get Analysis-Type from opt
anal_type = opt$anal_type # used throughout report
background_filter = { if(is.null(opt$background_filter)) FALSE else opt$background_filter } # used in descriptive text
pval_comb = opt$pval_comb # used in descriptive text
impact_metric = opt$impact_metric # used in volcano plot
top_n_networks = opt$top_n_networks # used in heatmap caption
if (!is.null(opt$ome_gct)) { multiomic = TRUE } else { multiomic = FALSE }


# counter variable for figures and tables
fig_count <- 1
tab_count <- 1

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

cat("# Overview\n")

# determine pathway database
if (is.null(opt$pthw_db)) {
  pathway_database_text = "(<code>pthw_db</code> parameter missing)"
  opt$pthw_db = "" # set to empty string to avoid errors
} else {
  if ( opt$pthw_db == "kegg" ) {
    pathway_database_text = "a curated subset of metabolomic pathways from the KEGG Database"
  } else if ( opt$pthw_db == "smpdb" ) {
    pathway_database_text = "a curated subset of metabolomic pathways from the Small Molecule Pathway Database"
  } else {
    pathway_database_text = glue("a curated subset of metabolomic pathways from the {opt$pthw_db} Database")
  }
}

# generate overview text, based on the analysis type and p-value combination method
cat("This document describes the results of the MetaboAnalyst module, which performs pathway enrichment analysis on metabolites and genes. ")
cat(paste0("Pathway enrichment was performed on the ", pathway_database_text," pathway database. "))
cat("\n\n")

# generate text describing analysis type
if (anal_type=="ORA") {
  cat("Pathway enrichment analysis was performed using the Overrepresentation Analysis (ORA) method. ")
  cat("For each annotation of interest, for each subvalue, a list of significantly differentially expressed features was calculated via a one-v-all 2-sample mod-T-test. ")
  cat("These features were then used as the input of a hypergeometric test, to determine if any pathways are overrepresented in differentially expressed features. ")
} else {
  cat("Pathway enrichment analysis was performed using the Quantitative Enrichment Analysis (QEA) method. A global test was performed across all features in a pathway, to identify differential expression across samples of a given annotation-subvalue. ")
}
# generate text describing p-value combination method (if applicable)
if (multiomic) {
  if (pval_comb=="query") {
    cat("Analysis was performed on both metabolites and genes together. ")
  } else {
    cat("Analysis was performed on metabolites and genes separately; ")
    if (pval_comb=="pvalu") {
      cat("p-values were combined using a weighted z-test, with equal weight given to metabolites and genes. ")
    } else if (pval_comb=="pvalo") {
      cat("p-values were combined using a weighted z-test, with weights given to metabolites and genes based on their respective proportions in the pathway database overall. ")
    } else if (pval_comb=="pvalp") {
      cat("p-values were combined using a weighted z-test, with weights given to metabolites and genes based on their respective proportions in each individual pathway tested. ")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Analysis was performed on metabolites only. ")
}


# point to PANOPLY Wiki for more information
cat("\n\nFor more information about the module please visit the [PANOPLY Wiki page](https://github.com/broadinstitute/PANOPLY/wiki/Data-Analysis-Modules%3A-panoply_metaboanalyst), or refer to the original [MetaboAnalyst](https://www.metaboanalyst.ca/home.xhtml) software. ")
# add disclaimer to note that we've changed how pathway featuers are counted
if (anal_type=="ORA") {
  cat(paste0("Please note that, due to a change in the way unique features are counted, ",
  if(background_filter) "as well as pathway-level filtering to features observed in the provided dataset, " else "",
  "results will differ between this report and the original MetaboAnalyst software. "))
}
cat("\n")
```

```{r prep_data, include=FALSE}

# # check that results exist at all
# xls_files = list.files(pattern = "_fullResults.xls")  # locate XLS results file
# if (length(xls_files) < 1) stop(glue("Tarfile {params$metaboanalyst_results} is missing XLS files with enrichment results."))

#### Create df_annot ####
df_annot = data.frame()
for (annot_of_interest in unique(log_file$annot.name)) {
# for (annot_of_interest in c("NMF.consensus.k3", "NMF.consensus.core.k3", "NMF.consensus.k6", "NMF.consensus.core.k6")) {
  log_file.tmp = filter(log_file, annot.name==annot_of_interest) %>% # check log for results
    column_to_rownames('subvalue.name') # set unique subvalue names to rownames, for easy lookup
  if (!any(log_file.tmp$valid.results)) next # skip if no annot has valid results
  
  # # if there are valid results
  # res_file = list.files(pattern = glue("_{annot_of_interest}_fullResults.xls$")) # all XLS results
  # #write(res_file, file='/opt/input/tmp.txt', append=TRUE)
  # # sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(fn)
  
  for(value_of_interest.name in rownames(log_file.tmp)) {
    if(!log_file.tmp[value_of_interest.name,"valid.results"]) next # don't show invalid / blank subvalues
    value_of_interest = log_file.tmp[value_of_interest.name,"subvalue.value"] # get original annot value for use in analysis
    res_file = list.files(path = glue('results_{annot_of_interest}'),  pattern = glue("_{annot_of_interest}_{value_of_interest.name}_results.csv$"), full.names = T)  # get results CSV file

    
    if( length(res_file) <1 ) {
      stop(glue("Annotation subvalue '{value_of_interest}' should have valid results, but does not have a corresponding CSV in 'results_{annot_of_interest}/'."))
    }
    if( length(res_file) >1 ) {
      stop(glue("Multiple matching results files found for '{value_of_interest}' in the 'results_{annot_of_interest}/'  folder."))
    }
    
    df.tmp = read.csv(res_file) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Pathway.ID = "X") %>% # set first column to rownames
      dplyr::mutate(Annot = annot_of_interest,
                    Subvalue = value_of_interest) %>%
      dplyr::select(Annot, Subvalue, Pathway.ID, everything())
    df_annot = rbind(df_annot, df.tmp)
  }
}

#### Heatmap base64 Array ####
imgObj = list()
for (annot_of_interest in unique(log_file$annot.name)) {
  hm_file = list.files(pattern = glue("_{annot_of_interest}_heatmap.png$"))
  
  if (length(hm_file)==0) next # don't add anything if it doesn't exist
  imgObj[[annot_of_interest]] = knitr::image_uri(hm_file) # otherwise convert file to base64 and add to array 
}
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; /* use same font as Rmarkdown */
  color: #303030; /* use same font-color as Rmarkdown */
  --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 6px 10px 0px,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 0px 0px 1px;
  --color: #166e67;
  --gap: 0.5rem;
  --radius: 5px;
}

body {
  margin: 2rem;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* Table container - matches figure flex structure */
.table-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
}

#div_table {
  height: 500px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}

/* DataTables styling improvements */
#myTable {
    font-size: 1rem;
    border-collapse: collapse;
}

/* table header cell styling - target the actual sorting header */
.dt-scroll-headInner th,
#myTable thead th {
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #dee2e6;
    padding: 10px 8px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    text-align: center;
}

/* Make the duplicate header in scroll body invisible but keep it for column alignment */
.dt-scroll-body thead th {
    visibility: hidden;
}

/* Ensure column widths match between header and body */
.dt-scroll-headInner table,
.dt-scroll-body table {
    width: 100% !important;
}

/* table body cell styling */
#myTable tbody td {
    padding: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
    text-align: right;
}

/* hover styling for rows - make it clear they're clickable */
#myTable tbody tr {
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}
#myTable tbody tr:hover {
    background-color: #e3f2fd !important; /* Light blue to indicate interactivity */
}
#myTable tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background-color: #fafafa;
}
#myTable tbody tr:nth-child(even):hover {
    background-color: #e3f2fd !important; /* Light blue to indicate interactivity */
}

/* NA value styling */
.na-value {
    color: #999;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* caption styles */
#table-caption, #volcano-caption, #network-caption {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
#table-caption p, #volcano-caption p, #network-caption p {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 5px 0;
}

hr {
    margin-top: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* other figure formatting */
.parent {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
}
.flex-child {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
#div_volcano, #div_network {
  height: 400px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.dropdown-menu {
  position: relative;
  display: contents;
}

/* Tooltip style */
.tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  padding: 5px;
  background-color: #ddd;
  color: black;
  border-radius: 5px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  user-select: text;
}

.axis-label {
  fill: #000;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-anchor: middle;
  font-weight: bold;
}
```

```{js, echo=FALSE}
//// ---- Data Wrangling


// parse Networks
const json_network = JSON.parse(json_network_str);
console.log(json_network)

// parse Network Annotations
const json_net_anno = JSON.parse(json_net_anno_str);
console.log(json_net_anno)



//// ---- Utility Functions
function onlyUnique(value, index, array) {
  return array.indexOf(value) === index;
}
function getMax(arr, prop) {
  var max;
  for (var i=0 ; i<arr.length ; i++) {
    if (max == null || parseFloat(arr[i][prop]) > parseFloat(max))
      max = arr[i][prop];
  }
  return max;
}
function removeOptions(selectElement) {
   var i, L = selectElement.options.length - 1;
   for(i = L; i >= 0; i--) {
      selectElement.remove(i);
   }
}
// Function to merge two arrays based on matching `id`
function mergeJSONObjects(data1, data2, key) {
    return data1.map(item1 => {
        // Find the corresponding item from data2 by matching `id`
        const item2 = data2.find(item => item[key] === item1[key]);
        
        // If a matching item is found, merge them, otherwise return item1 as it is
        return item2 ? { ...item1, ...item2 } : item1;
    });
}
function dropItem(arr, item) {
  const index = arr.indexOf(item);
  if (index > -1) { // only splice array when item is found
    arr.splice(index, 1); // 2nd parameter means remove one item only
  }
  return arr
}

// -- Update subvalue Menu                   
function updateSubvalueMenu() {
  // -- clear menu
  removeOptions(subvalueMenu)
  // -- add default value
  subvalueMenu.append( new Option(text="Select Annotation Subvalue",
                                  value="none"))
  subvalueMenu.options[0].disabled = true // set first valid result to selected
  subvalueMenu.options[0].hidden = true // set first valid result to selected
  subvalueMenu.options[0].selected = true // set first valid result to selected
  
  // -- get relevant subvalues
  var log_subvalue = log_file.filter((entry,index,arr) => entry["annot.name"]==annotMenu.options[annotMenu.selectedIndex].text)
  
  // -- add subvlues to subvalueMenu & format
  log_subvalue.forEach((entry, index, arr) => {
    // create new option for each subvalue
    //subvalueMenu.options[subvalueMenu.options.length] = new Option(entry['subvalue.value'], entry['subvalue.name']);
    subvalueMenu.append( new Option(text=entry['subvalue.value'],
                                    value=entry['subvalue.name']))
    
    // disable subvalue if no valid results
    subvalueMenu.options[index+1].disabled = !entry['valid.results'] // offset by 1 since we have a default
    
    //// select first valid option
    //var selected_index = arr.map((entry) => entry['valid.results']).findIndex(value => value === true) // get first valid result
    //subvalueMenu.options[index].selected = index===selected_index // set first valid result to selected
  });
  
  //console.log(subvalueMenu))
}

//// ---- Heatmaps
function updateHeatmap(annot) {
    document.img_heatmap.src = imgArr[annot];
}
updateHeatmap(log_file[0]['annot.name']) //initialize with first annot

//// ---- Initialize DataTable
const columnNames = Object.keys(json_annot[0]) // Extract column names from annot-table
function clearTable(table) {
  // clear all the elements of the table by searching for NA, which should not exist
  table
    .column(columnNames.indexOf("Annot")).search('NA', { exact: true }) // search for NA
    .column(columnNames.indexOf("Subvalue")).search('NA', { exact: true })  // search for NA
    .draw()
  // clear caption
  const captionDiv = document.getElementById("table-caption");
  if (captionDiv) captionDiv.innerHTML = '';
}
function initializeDT(df, columnNames) {
  // Format column names for display (capitalize first letter)
  const formattedColumnNames = columnNames.map(function(column) {
    return column.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + column.slice(1).replace(/\./g, ' ');
  });
  
  // identify columns to hide
  let col_to_filt = ['Annot', 'Subvalue', 'Pathway.ID', 'Test.Type'] 
      .concat(dropItem(["Impact.BC", "Impact.CC", "Impact.DC"], impact_metric))
  
  // Hide Observed.Entries and N.Hits if individual columns exist
  const hasIndividualColumns = columnNames.includes('Observed.Entries.Genes') || 
                               columnNames.includes('Observed.Entries.Compounds') ||
                               columnNames.includes('N.Hits.Genes') || 
                               columnNames.includes('N.Hits.Compounds');
  if (hasIndividualColumns) {
    if (columnNames.includes('Observed.Entries')) {
      col_to_filt.push('Observed.Entries');
    }
    if (columnNames.includes('N.Hits')) {
      col_to_filt.push('N.Hits');
    }
  }
  
  let filt_idx = [];
  col_to_filt.forEach(entry => filt_idx.push(columnNames.indexOf(entry)))
  // identify Raw.P.Value column
  const search_idx = columnNames.indexOf("Pathway.Name")
  const sort_idx = columnNames.indexOf("Raw.P.Value")
  
  // Detect numeric columns (while ignoring null-like values)
  const isNumericValue = function(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '' || value === 'null') {
      return false;
    }
    return !isNaN(Number(value));
  };
  const numericColumnFlags = columnNames.map(function(_, idx) { // for each column idx
    return df.some(function(row) {
      const value = Object.values(row)[idx]; // for each row value in this column
      return isNumericValue(value); // check if the value is numeric
    });
  });
  
  // Initialize DataTables
  const table = new DataTable('#myTable', {
    data: df.map(Object.values), // convert to array of arrays
    columns: columnNames.map(function(col, idx) {
      return { 
        title: formattedColumnNames[idx],
        data: idx,
        type: numericColumnFlags[idx] ? 'num' : 'string',
        render: function(data, type, row) {
          // Handle null, undefined, or empty string values
          if (data === null || data === undefined || data === 'null' || data === '') {
            if (type !== 'display') { // if not displaying, return empty string
              return '';
            }
            return '<span class="na-value">NA</span>'; // if displaying, return NA value
          }
          return data;
        }
      };
    }),
    scrollY: 400, // scroll height
    scrollX: true, // enable horizontal scrolling
    scrollCollapse: true, // collapse height if fewer entries
    paging: false,
    // pageLength: 25, // show 25 rows per page
    lengthChange: true, // allow user to change page length
    lengthMenu: [[10, 25, 50, 100, -1], [10, 25, 50, 100, "All"]],
    order: [sort_idx, 'asc'], // sort by p-value
    columnDefs: [
      { visible: false, targets: filt_idx }, // hide filtered columns
      { searchable: true, targets: search_idx },
      { targets: '_all', className: 'text-center' }, // center align headers
    ],
    dom: 'lfrtip', // layout: length, filter, processing, table, info, pagination
    language: {
      search: "Search:",
      lengthMenu: "Show _MENU_ entries",
      info: "Showing _START_ to _END_ of _TOTAL_ entries",
      infoEmpty: "No entries to show",
      infoFiltered: "(filtered from _MAX_ total entries)"
    },
    initComplete: function() {
      // Ensure column widths are synchronized after initialization
      const api = this.api();
      api.columns.adjust();
      
      // Add row click handler to update network viewer
      $('#myTable tbody').on('click', 'tr', function() {
        const rowData = api.row(this).data();
        if (rowData) {
          // Find Pathway.ID and Pathway.Name column indices
          const pathwayIdIdx = columnNames.indexOf('Pathway.ID');
          const pathwayNameIdx = columnNames.indexOf('Pathway.Name');
          
          if (pathwayIdIdx !== -1 && pathwayNameIdx !== -1) {
            const pathwayId = rowData[pathwayIdIdx];
            const pathwayName = rowData[pathwayNameIdx];
            
            // Only update if we have valid values
            if (pathwayId && pathwayId !== 'null' && pathwayName && pathwayName !== 'null') {
              console.log('Clicked row: ' + pathwayName + ' (' + pathwayId + ')');
              updateNetwork(pathwayId, pathwayName);
            }
          }
        }
      });
      
      // Add hover effect to indicate rows are clickable
      $('#myTable tbody').on('mouseenter', 'tr', function() {
        $(this).css('cursor', 'pointer');
      });
    }
  });
  
  // hide all rows initially
  clearTable(table);
  
  return table
}
var table = initializeDT(json_annot, columnNames) // set table variable

//// ---- Update DataTable
function updateDataTable(table, columnNames, annot_filt, subval_filt) {
  table
    .column(columnNames.indexOf("Annot")).search(annot_filt, { exact: true })
    .column(columnNames.indexOf("Subvalue")).search(subval_filt, { exact: true })
    .draw()
  
  // Adjust column widths after drawing to ensure header/body alignment
  setTimeout(function() {
    table.columns.adjust();
  }, 0);
  
  // Update table caption with N.Sign.DF and N.Obs.Overall values
  updateTableCaption(annot_filt, subval_filt)
}

//// ---- Update Table Caption
function updateTableCaption(annot_filt, subval_filt) {
  const captionDiv = document.getElementById("table-caption");
  if (!captionDiv) return;
  
  // Find matching log_file entry
  const logEntry = log_file.find(function(entry) {
    return entry['annot.name'] === annot_filt && entry['subvalue.value'] === subval_filt;
  });
  
  if (!logEntry) {
    captionDiv.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  
  // Build caption text
  let captionText = '<p><b>Table 1:</b> This table shows pathway enrichment results in ' +
    subval_filt + ' samples. ';
  
  if (anal_type == "ORA") {
    // Build N.Sign.DF and N.Obs.Overall descriptions
    let nSignText = '';
    let nObsText = '';
    if (logEntry['N.Sign.DF.Compounds'] != null && !isNaN(logEntry['N.Sign.DF.Compounds'])) { // check if compound data is present
      nSignText = logEntry['N.Sign.DF.Compounds'] + ' metabolites';
      nObsText = logEntry['N.Obs.Overall.Compounds'] + ' metabolites';
      if (logEntry['N.Sign.DF.Genes'] != null && !isNaN(logEntry['N.Sign.DF.Genes'])) { // check if gene data is present
        nSignText += ' and ' + logEntry['N.Sign.DF.Genes'] + ' genes';
        nObsText += ' and ' + logEntry['N.Obs.Overall.Genes'] + ' genes';
      }
    } else { // otherwise, use combined data
      nSignText = logEntry['N.Sign.DF'] + ' metabolites and genes';
      nObsText = logEntry['N.Obs.Overall'] + ' metabolites and genes';
    }
    // Build caption text
    captionText += 'A list of significantly differentially expressed features (' + nSignText + 
      ') was used as the input of Overrepresentation Analysis, across the observed features in the pathway database (' + 
      nObsText + ').';
  } else {
    // Build caption text
    captionText += 'Quantitative Enrichment Analysis was performed via a global test across all observed features in each pathway.';
  }
  
  captionText += '</p>';
  captionDiv.innerHTML = captionText;
}




//// ---- Update Volcano Plot
// function to remove volcano object
function clearVolcano() {
  if (document.getElementById("svg_volcano")) { document.getElementById("svg_volcano").remove() }
  if (document.getElementById("point_vals_volcano")) { document.getElementById("point_vals_volcano").remove() }
  // clear caption
  const captionDiv = document.getElementById("volcano-caption");
  if (captionDiv) captionDiv.innerHTML = '';
}
// function to create/update volcano plot
function updateVolcano(df, annot_filt, subval_filt) {
  y_val = "neg.Log.P.Value"
  x_val = impact_metric
  // filter json to annot_filt
  const df_annot = df.filter((entry,index,arr) => entry["Annot"]===annot_filt )
  //console.log(json_annot)
  // further filter json to subval_filt
  const df_subv = df_annot.filter((entry,index,arr) => entry["Subvalue"]===subval_filt )
  
  // if we've already made the thing, remove it
  clearVolcano()
  
  // get width of container object
  const containerWidth = document.querySelector('.parent').offsetWidth
  
  // Declare the chart dimensions and margins.
  const width = containerWidth/2*0.95;
  const height = 400;
  const marginTop = 20;
  const marginRight = 20;
  const marginBottom = 60;
  const marginLeft = 60;

  // Declare the x (horizontal position) scale.
  const x = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, getMax(df_annot, x_val)+0.5]) // use same dimensions for annot
      .range([marginLeft, width - marginRight]);

  // Declare the y (vertical position) scale.
  const y = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, getMax(df_annot, y_val)+0.5]) // use same dimensions for annot
      .range([height - marginBottom, marginTop]);

  // Create the SVG container.
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("id", "svg_volcano"); // give it an ID so I can remove and refresh


  // Add the x-axis.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height - marginBottom})`)
      .call(d3.axisBottom(x))
      // Add label
      .append('text')
      .attr('class', 'axis-label')
      .text(impact_metric)
      .attr('x', (marginLeft + (width - marginLeft - marginRight) / 2)) // Relative to the x axis.
      .attr('y', 40)

  // Add the y-axis.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y))
      // Add label
      .append('text')
      .attr('class', 'axis-label')
      .text("-log(P.Value)")
      .attr('transform', 'rotate(-90)')
      .attr('x', -(marginTop + (height - marginTop - marginBottom) / 2))
      .attr('y', -40) // Relative to the y axis.


  // Append the SVG element.
  div_volcano.append(svg.node());

  // mouseover text
  const point_vals = d3.select("#div_volcano")
    .append("p")
    .attr("align", "left")
    .attr("id", "point_vals_volcano")
    //.text("Mouseover points for more info, and click to show Pathway Network!");

  // Add the scatterplot
  //const pval_signif_num = Number(pval_signif);
  svg.selectAll(".dots")
      .data(df_subv)
    .enter().append("circle")
      .attr("class", "dots")
      .attr("fill", function(d) {
        return ( Number(d["BH.P.Value"]) <= Number(pval_signif) ) ? "orangered" : "#BDBDBD";
        //return d.type === "A" ? "steelblue" : "orangered";
      })
      .attr("fill-opacity", 0.3)
      .attr("r", 5)
      .attr("cx", d => x(d[x_val]) )
      .attr("cy", d => y(d[y_val]) )
      .on("mouseover", function(d){
         d3.selectAll(".dots").attr("r", 5) //make sure all the dots are small
         d3.select(this)
          .transition(bounce_select)
          .attr("r", 10);
        
        // show tooltip
        tooltip.transition().duration(200).style("opacity", .8);		
              tooltip.html("<b/>Pathway: </b>" + d["Pathway.Name"] + '\n' +
                          "-log(P) = " + d[y_val]+ '\n' +
                          x_val + " = " + d[x_val])
                .style("left", (d3.event.pageX) + "px")
                .style("top", (d3.event.pageY) + "px");
      }) // mouseover behavior
      .on("mouseout", function(d){
        // remove tooltip
        tooltip.transition().duration(200).style("opacity", 0);
      }) // mouseout behavior
      .on("click", function(d) {
         //console.log(json)
         console.log( "clicked " + d["Pathway.Name"] + " (" + d["Pathway.ID"] + ")" )
         updateNetwork(d["Pathway.ID"], d["Pathway.Name"])
      }); // click behavior

  // Update caption
  if (impact_metric == "Impact.BC") {
    impact_metric_text = "Betweenness Centrality";
  } else if (impact_metric == "Impact.CC") {
    impact_metric_text = "Closeness Centrality";
  } else if (impact_metric == "Impact.DC") {
    impact_metric_text = "Degree Centrality";
  }
  const captionDiv = document.getElementById("volcano-caption");
  if (captionDiv) {
    captionDiv.innerHTML = '<p><b>Figure 2:</b> This scatterplot shows the relationship between the topologically impact of significant hits on the pathway network (<code>' +
      impact_metric_text + '</code>) and statistical significance of the pathway enrichment test (<code>-log(P.Value)</code>). Click on a point to view the pathway network diagram.</p>';
  }
  
}

// updateNetwork()
// Update Network Plot
function clearNetwork() {
  if (document.getElementById("svg_network")) { document.getElementById("svg_network").remove() }
  // clear caption
  const captionDiv = document.getElementById("network-caption");
  if (captionDiv) captionDiv.innerHTML = '';
}
function updateNetwork(pthw_id, pthw_name) {
  //console.log(pthw_id)
  
  clearNetwork()
  let tooltipPinned = false;
  let pinnedNodeId = null;
  
  // pull network info
  const df_network = json_network[pthw_id]
  // pull network annotations
  const df_net_anno = json_net_anno[annotMenu.options[annotMenu.selectedIndex].text][subvalueMenu.options[subvalueMenu.selectedIndex].value][pthw_id]
  
  // set up links / nodes objects
  const links = df_network.links;
  const nodes = mergeJSONObjects(df_network.nodes, df_net_anno, 'id'); // merge nodes with node-annotations by id
  //console.log(getMax(nodes, 'graphics_x'))
  
  // color-scale for nodes
  // color-scale for non-logFC colored nodes
  const khroma_blue = '#2166AC'; // khroma BuRd palette
  const khroma_grey = '#F7F7F7'; // khroma BuRd palette
  const khroma_red = '#B2182B'; // khroma BuRd palette
  const observed_color = "#666666"; // dark grey
  const not_observed_color = "#BBBBBB"; // grey
  const max_logFC = 3; // logFC will range from -5 to 5 for now
  const nodeColor = d3.scaleSequential().domain([-max_logFC,max_logFC])
  .interpolator(d3.interpolateRgbBasis([khroma_blue, khroma_grey, khroma_red])); 
  // node size
  const node_size = 10
  console.log('test')
  
  function renderNodeTooltip(d) {
    const nodeTitle = d.link
      ? '<a href="' + d.link + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><b><u>' + d.graphics_name + '</u></b></a>'
      : '<b><u>' + d.graphics_name + '</u></b>';
    tooltip.html(nodeTitle + "<br>" +
                 "<b>Hits In Dataset: </b>" + d['hits.all.hr'] + "<br>" +
                 "<b>Significant Hits: </b>" + d['hits.sign.hr'] + "<br>" +
                 "<b>LogFC Values: </b>" + d['logFC.all.sign'])
      .style("left", (d3.event.pageX) + "px")
      .style("top", (d3.event.pageY) + "px");
  }
  
  function hideNodeTooltip() {
    tooltip.style("pointer-events", "none")
      .transition().duration(200).style("opacity", 0);
    tooltipPinned = false;
    pinnedNodeId = null;
  }
  
  // get width of container object
  const containerWidth = document.querySelector('.parent').offsetWidth
  
  // set the dimensions and margins of the graph
  const margin = {top: 10, right: 30, bottom: 30, left: 40},
    width = containerWidth/2*0.95 - margin.left - margin.right,
    height = 400 - margin.top - margin.bottom;

  // Create the scales for x and y
  const xScale = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([d3.min(nodes, d => d.graphics_x), d3.max(nodes, d => d.graphics_x)])  // Domain from data's min and max x values
    .range([0, width]);  // Range from 0 to the SVG width
  const yScale = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([d3.min(nodes, d => d.graphics_y), d3.max(nodes, d => d.graphics_y)])  // Domain from data's min and max y values
    .range([0,height]);  // Range from SVG height to 0
  
  // append the svg object to the body of the page
  const svg = d3.select("#div_network")
  .append("svg")
    .attr("width", width + margin.left + margin.right)
    .attr("height", height + margin.top + margin.bottom)
      .attr("id", "svg_network") // give it an ID so I can remove and refresh
  .append("g")
    .attr("transform",
          "translate(" + margin.left + "," + margin.top + ")");


  
  // Define the arrow marker
  svg.append("defs")
    .append("marker")
    .attr("id", "arrowhead")
    .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10") // the bounding box for the arrowhead
    .attr("refX", 20) // position of the arrow relative to the line
    .attr("refY", 0)
    .attr("orient", "auto")
    .attr("markerWidth", 6)
    .attr("markerHeight", 6)
    .append("path")
    .attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5") // the path to draw the arrow
    .attr("class", "arrowhead");
  
  

  
  
  // Create links (lines connecting nodes)
  svg.selectAll(".link")
    .data(links)
    .enter().append("line")
    .style("stroke", "#aaa")
    .attr("class", "link")
    .attr("x1", d => xScale(nodes[nodes.map(e => e['id']).findIndex(n => n == d.source)].graphics_x))
    .attr("y1", d => yScale(nodes[nodes.map(e => e['id']).findIndex(n => n == d.source)].graphics_y))
    .attr("x2", d => xScale(nodes[nodes.map(e => e['id']).findIndex(n => n == d.target)].graphics_x))
    .attr("y2", d => yScale(nodes[nodes.map(e => e['id']).findIndex(n => n == d.target)].graphics_y))
    .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)");;
  

  // Initialize the nodes
  //console.log(nodes)
  //console.log(nodes[1].graphics_type)
  const node = svg.selectAll(".node")
    .data(nodes)
    //.enter().append("circle")
    .enter().append(d => d.graphics_type === 'circle'
                    ? document.createElementNS(d3.namespaces.svg, "circle")
                    : document.createElementNS(d3.namespaces.svg, "rect"))
    .attr("class", "node")
    //.style("fill", "#69b3a2")
    .style("fill", function(d) { 
      //const hits = d["hits.all"];
      const value = d["logFC.absmax"];
      //console.log(hits)
      if (value != null) { // if there are significant hits / non-null logFC value
        return nodeColor(value); // use logFC color-scale
      } else if (d["hits.all.hr"].length != 0) { // if there is at least one hit (but no logFC value)
        return observed_color; // use dark grey
      } else {
        return not_observed_color;  // use grey if there were no hits
      }
    })
  // circle coords / aesthetics
    .attr("cx", d => d.graphics_type === 'circle' ? xScale(d.graphics_x) : null)
    .attr("cy", d => d.graphics_type === 'circle' ? yScale(d.graphics_y) : null)
    .attr("r", node_size/2 )  // Set radius for circles
  // square coords / aesthetics
    .attr("x", d => d.graphics_type === 'circle' ? null : xScale(d.graphics_x)-node_size/2)
    .attr("y", d => d.graphics_type === 'circle' ? null : yScale(d.graphics_y)-node_size/2)
    .attr("width", node_size) // Set width for squares
    .attr("height", node_size) // Set height for squares
    .on("mouseover", function(d){
      if (tooltipPinned && pinnedNodeId !== d.id) return;
      // circle behavior
      d3.selectAll(".circles").attr("r", node_size/2) //make sure all the dots are small
      d3.select(this)
        .transition(bounce_select)
        .attr("r", node_size);
      // square behavior
      d3.selectAll(".rect") //make sure all the dots are 
      d3.select(this)
        .transition(bounce_select)
        .attr("x", xScale(d.graphics_x)-node_size) // adjust coords to center
        .attr("y", yScale(d.graphics_y)-node_size)
        .attr("width", node_size*2) // double size
        .attr("height", node_size*2);
      
      // show tooltip
      tooltip.style("pointer-events", "none")
        .transition().duration(200).style("opacity", .8);
      renderNodeTooltip(d);
    }) // mouseover behavior
    .on("mouseout", function(d){
      // circle behavior
      d3.selectAll(".circles") //make sure all the dots are small
      d3.select(this)
        .transition(bounce_select)
        .attr("r", node_size/2);
      // square behavior
      d3.selectAll(".rect") //make sure all the dots are 
      d3.select(this)
        .transition(bounce_select)
        .attr("x", xScale(d.graphics_x)-node_size/2)
        .attr("y", yScale(d.graphics_y)-node_size/2)
        .attr("width", node_size)
        .attr("height", node_size);
      // remove tooltip
      if (!tooltipPinned) {
        tooltip.transition().duration(200).style("opacity", 0);
      }
    }) // mouseout behavior
    .on("click", function(d){
      d3.event.stopPropagation();
      if (tooltipPinned && pinnedNodeId === d.id) {
        hideNodeTooltip();
      } else {
        tooltipPinned = true;
        pinnedNodeId = d.id;
        tooltip.style("pointer-events", "auto")
          .style("opacity", .95);
        renderNodeTooltip(d);
      }
    });
  
  d3.select("body").on("click.networkTooltip", function() {
    if (tooltipPinned) hideNodeTooltip();
  });
  
  // Update caption
  const captionDiv = document.getElementById("network-caption");
  if (captionDiv) {
    if (anal_type == "ORA") {
      color_text = '<br><span style="margin-left: 1.5em; display: inline-block;">' +
        '<span style="color:'+khroma_red+';">■</span> significantly upregulated<br>'+
        '<span style="color:'+khroma_blue+';">■</span> significantly downregulated<br>'+
        '<span style="color:'+observed_color+';">■</span> observed but not significant<br>'+
        '<span style="color:'+not_observed_color+';">■</span> not observed' +
        '</span>';
    } else {
      color_text = '<br><span style="margin-left: 1.5em; display: inline-block;">' +
        '<span style="color:'+observed_color+';">■</span> observed in dataset<br>'+
        '<span style="color:'+not_observed_color+';">■</span> not observed in dataset'
        '</span>';
    }
    captionDiv.innerHTML = '<p><b>Figure 3:</b> This network diagram shows the pathway structure for <code>' +
      pthw_name + '</code>, with circles representing metabolites and squares representing genes. Hover over a node to view additional details. ' +
      '<br><br><b>Nodes Color Key:</b> ' + color_text +
      '</p>';
  }
}
```
